# sigma_connection_table_columns (Data Source)

List columns for a connection table. The `type` field is a recursive object; surfaced as `type_json` for downstream JSON parsing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The column list for a Sigma-tracked connection table. Useful when you need
# to code-generate workbook column references in larger automation pipelines.
data "sigma_connection_table_columns" "customers" {
  table_id = "<connection-table-id-here>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `table_id` (String) Connection table UUID (from `sigma_connection_path` or similar).

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `type_json` (String) JSON-encoded column type spec (recursive).
- `visibility` (String) `included`, `hidden`, or `removed`.
